limitations: Exactness is against the completed emulator framebuffer, including sprites and palettes. Hardware timing, full fights, controllers and browser listening remain separate checks.
Native reference captures are savable editable copies; native ROM writing remains restricted to declared source-template recipes.
Header compatibility ignores only padding bytes 12–15. Mapper, sizes, PRG/CHR and immutable audio data remain checked.
